name: Code check
responsibility: Holds each board's anchors, bound symbols, relationships, interfaces and document references to the code they name, at the current variant or the named draft; one run gives behind beside it
description: ADR 0046's code pass over the files Git does not ignore in the vault's own checkout and the chosen ones, through code facts: a bound symbol must be a definition, an anchor's symbol a definition or a use that supports its relationship (in the bound code of an end, of an evidence kind the relationship's kind accepts), and on a named draft a bound path must be in its checkout. Each document reference of the variant read must name a file at its branch or commit (ADR 0054). Evidence between a board's bound parts comes from the code facts of every bound file, owned by the narrowest binding (a C, C++ or Objective-C file's part owns its pair): a run-time use through an import or include is a call, a type-only use an import. It joins an environment value that bound code reads with the compose service, Kubernetes workload or Terraform resource that runs that code (by its build, or a part drawn inside the part bound to it) and sets the value to another part's address: configured-path evidence. It reports the part code reaches with no relationship, and as information a relationship with no anchor whose accepted evidence runs only backwards or is missing (across a network hop, the side without evidence). For a container bound to a module it holds ADR 0044's interface to what the module exposes, and reads a Terraform module's pass-through variables and whether it is shallow. A binding to a Terraform root module names an address there; references join resource-bound parts, and --plan names plan JSON files. Kubernetes Service selectors and NetworkPolicies join workload-bound parts by labels, and a reference to a Service no part binds reaches the workloads it picks. A language server resolves the uses no import resolves, and a C use an include leads only to a declaration; the servers each checkout's registration holds decide which one runs there. It lists what it skipped and why. src/shared/code-check/index.ts names each finding code.
